key: Ask where the cells started: surface ectoderm covers, neuroectoderm stays in the neural tube, neural crest migrates away from it, mesoderm builds the middle, and endoderm lines the gut tube and its buds.
items: The lens placode thickens from surface ectoderm where the optic vesicle touches it, so the lens is surface ectoderm.
Rathke pouch grows up from the roof of the primitive mouth, which is lined by surface ectoderm.
Surface ectoderm forms the epidermis and its glands, and the ameloblasts that make enamel come from this layer too.
The optic cup is an outgrowth of the brain, so the retina and optic nerve are neuroectoderm.
The infundibulum grows down from the floor of the diencephalon, so the posterior pituitary is neural tissue.
The caudal neural tube becomes the spinal cord. Failure of the posterior neuropore to close causes spina bifida.
Neural crest cells migrate into the adrenal gland and become chromaffin cells that secrete epinephrine.
Pigment cells migrate from the neural crest into the skin.
Crest cells colonize the gut wall from above downward. Failure to reach the distal colon causes Hirschsprung disease.
The cortex develops from mesoderm lining the coelom near the gonadal ridge, unlike the crest-derived medulla it surrounds.
Intermediate mesoderm forms the urogenital ridge, which builds both the kidneys and the gonads.
Splanchnic lateral plate mesoderm forms the heart tube, the blood islands and the vessel walls.
The thyroid follicular cells come from the endoderm of the gut tube, so they are endoderm.
Both glands bud from the endodermal lining of the gut tube, so their epithelium is endoderm.
The airway lining grows out of the endoderm of the gut tube, so it is endoderm.
